hooks.name: Run Parser Tests on Save
hooks.description: When a connector, a parser or the normalizer is saved, run contract tests and PBT (runs from the repo root, Windows PowerShell safe: no cd, no chaining)

action.command: backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest -c backend/pytest.ini backend/tests/test_connectors.py backend/tests/test_properties.py backend/tests/test_whatsapp_parser.py -q --tb=short
